# TherapyPA

> Private-pay online therapy in Pennsylvania with Bill Curtin, LCSW.
> Practical help and deeper self-understanding via secure telehealth.

Bill Curtin is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (PA license CW025367, current through February 28, 2027) based in Philadelphia. TherapyPA is his solo practice, 100% private-pay. All sessions are online through secure telehealth, for adults located in Pennsylvania.

## Specialties
- Traumatic grief (loss with trauma: sudden death, violent loss, grief tangled with what happened)
- High-achiever burnout
- Men's mental health
- First responders (police, fire, EMS, dispatch)
- Anxiety and depression
- PTSD and trauma, including Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT)

## Approach
Certified in psychodynamic psychotherapy (Bryn Mawr, 2024) and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (Beck/Penn, 2024); trained in CPT (2021). Master's in Social Work from the University of Pennsylvania (2022). Before private practice, spent a decade in the victim services field and community behavioral health.

## Privacy
Private-pay by design: no insurer ever sees a diagnosis or treatment notes, and nothing goes to an employer. What clients share stays between them and Bill, within the standard legal and ethical limits all therapists follow.

## Practical details
- Fee: $200 per session; a limited number of reduced-fee spots available based on financial need
- Free 20-minute consultation to see if it's a good fit
- Does not bill insurance directly; provides superbills on request for out-of-network reimbursement
- Cancellation: at least 24 hours' notice; late cancellations and missed sessions are charged the full fee except in true emergencies
